117588.name: Chabad of Central Boca Raton
117588.note: Boca Raton Observer profile: Rivkah Denburg co-founded Chabad of Central Boca Raton in 1989 with her husband, Rabbi Moishe Denburg; a West Boca program guide (issuu) also has the couple arriving in Boca Raton in 1989, with Rabbi Zalman Bukiet (West Boca). therebbesimpact.com's 1974 is wrong.

117604.name: The Shul
117604.note: Chabad.org: 'in 1981, at the direction of the Rebbe ... Rabbi Sholom and Chani Lipskar founded The Shul of Bal Harbour'. Wikipedia: it 'initially met in hotel rooms before moving to a storefront', 'moved to its current site in 1987', and the building 'was opened in 1994, in time for Rosh Hashanah'. (Rabbi Lipskar himself came to Miami Beach in 1969, to the Landow Yeshiva.)

117883.name: The Aleph Institute
117883.note: Founded in 1981 by Rabbi Sholom Lipskar at the Rebbe's direction, for Jewish prisoners, their families and military personnel (Wikipedia; Rabbi Lipskar's Wikipedia page and Chabad.org's 2025 obituary also give 1981; one directory says 1985). Headquartered at The Shul.

120123.name: Lubavitch Educational Center
120123.note: Its About page: 'Our school was established by the Lubavitcher Rebbe in 1966 and opened with just seven children' (its home page says 1967). Chabad.org's obituary of Rabbi Avraham Korf (17 July 2025): 'The following year [after 1965], Rabbi Korf founded what was then called the Oholei Torah day school' in Miami Beach, which grew into the Lubavitch Educational Center. Now at 17330 NW 7th Ave, Miami Gardens.

earlier.where: Miami Beach (as the Oholei Torah day school)

117591.name: Chabad of Parkland - Regional HQ for North Broward & South Palm Beach
117591.note: The Coastal Star: the Bistons came to Miami in 1973 and worked in Aventura, Fort Lauderdale and Boca Raton 'before founding Chabad of Parkland in 1998'. Parkland Talk (1 Oct 2019, its new building opening for Rosh Hashanah 5780): 'They have been moving around Parkland for 20 years, beginning at The Winners Circle, then a storefront on 441 and Loxahatchee', then a small building on the present property. Rabbi Yosef Biston had founded the Chabad Center of Margate in 1985.

earlier.where: a storefront at US 441 and Loxahatchee Road
a small building on the present property

927742.name: French Chabad of Florida
927742.note: COLlive: Rabbi Yisroel and Louiza Frankforter 'have been servicing the French community of South Florida and the many French-speaking tourists who visit since 1991'. Lubavitch.com: 'sixteen years ago upon arriving in Miami' he advertised Torah classes for French speakers (that article's date unknown). Registered as the Jewish Educational Leadership Institute (EIN 20-, about 2004).

117603.name: Chabad of the Space & Treasure Coasts
117603.note: Its own timeline: 'When it all began 25 years ago... November 1990'; 'Chabad's first location at 750 Palm Drive'; 'Chabad Opens a Storefront Location, 1993'; 'Construction begins at the Chabad Jewish Community Center, 1998' (now 1190 Highway A1A, Satellite Beach). Lubavitch.com: Rabbi Zvi and Shulamit Konikov were newly appointed to Brevard County in 1990.

120129.name: Camp Gan Israel
120129.note: Chabad of the Space & Treasure Coasts' timeline: 'Launch of Camp Gan Israel, December 1991 ... Chabad opened the first Jewish day camp in Brevard - Camp Gan Israel - with dozens of young Jewish campers.'

119854.name: Torah Academy
119854.note: Chabad of the Space & Treasure Coasts' timeline: 'Launch of Torah Academy, 1995. Chabad opens the first Jewish school in the Space Coast'. Now at 7350 Lake Andrew Dr, Melbourne.

5362293.name: Friendship House
5362293.note: Jewish Boca: 'Since its founding in 2020, Friendship House has been a place where everyone is welcomed'; Boca ViewPointe (Mar 2024): 'Founded in 2020'. For special-needs families in south Palm Beach County (Rabbi Sholom Kessler).
